dis.text: Modar Bejiri receives his field hussar's brooch in the senate chamber of Grand Arbiter Augustin IV, completing his promotion, and then riding Ashmane through Tin Street Market he hears a man's last cry and finds blood in an alley.
He finds a woman in Boros uniform standing over an ogre's corpse, and when he tries to stop her the shapeshifter takes the exact form of the dead ogre, strikes him and breaks his binding spell.

The district imperator denies an arrest request because the Guildpact forbids direct action against a guild member without a warrant, so Modar requests an emergency writ of arrest for himself, handing over his brooch as the relic of authority.

Modar then baits the shapeshifter by announcing his name from the market stage, and the creature, now a troll, seizes him by the throat, and an Azorius arrest team tears the tent apart as Modar pulls its claws into his chest while it takes his form.
